programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When officers issue that final K-9 warning, it's the last chance to back down - surrender or face the dog. K-9 Scout collides head-on with an armed suspect who refuses to back down and K-9 Vlad, "The Impaler," squares up with a defiant driver who won't follow commands. In the dead of night, K-9 Edge tracks down and takes down two fleeing suspected thieves and K-9 ZAM methodically tears through a vehicle search, uncovering a laundry list of charges.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: As the sun goes down in a quiet farm town, K9 Rico is deployed to track down a man accused of strangling his neighbor; meanwhile, K9 Clooney springs into action when a desperate suspect makes a bold, shocking move-stealing a police cruiser in a last-ditch attempt to escape; K9 Murphy teams up with the aviation unit, combining forces in a relentless search for a suspect who fled after leading officers on a nearly 100-mile chase.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Just months from retirement, K9 Tasja is sent into a sprawling hotel with over 140 rooms, endless hiding spots and one suspect who refuses to be found; in another urgent search, K9 Midnight is called in to find a missing boy.

programs.title: Southern Law
programs.desc: A man in Jefferson County, Alabama comes clean about his drug stash and jokes his way out of being arrested; the air unit in Tulsa, Oklahoma uses their infrared camera to help catch an alleged thief hiding in the trash; officers in Midland County, Texas follow some timely leads to help catch a man with a felony warrant who's been running for 2 years.

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: In Cle Elum, Washington, Casey lost her dream home to a stranger who claimed it as her own for over 4 months and even tried to rent rooms out to other people for profit; but when Flash and his team move in, will their tactics be enough for this squatter to finally leave once and for all?

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: Flash Shelton and his team head to Vancouver, Washington to help a homeowner after a house sitter overstays her welcome and becomes an unwanted squatter; when Flash's team attempts to reclaim the home by using surveillance cameras, megaphones and even snakes, the confrontation turns into a tense standoff.
